race.comment: CRIMSON WALTZ (7) has needed plenty of time to mature, and she produced an encouraging effort to finish fourth here fresh up 3 weeks ago over 1210m. Rochelle Milnes keeps the ride, despite a wide gate, and in a very modest field, she can run into the top 3 for the first time. UNCOMMON MIND (11) did a lot wrong in the running and still managed to finish fourth, albeit well beaten, here 3 weeks ago over 1000m. She had won a trial before that, and with some natural improvement, she can figure in the top 3. IT'S A SOLID DEEL (6) has run the odd good race, and he was unsuited by the drop back to 1210m here last time out. He is worth another chance over this longer trip. Include. FULLHEADOFSTEAM (3) finished less than a length from the winner here 3 weeks ago, and will have the blinkers off for the first time here. Stick with him on an each-way basis. SOCIAL DANCER (10) may never win a race, but she is good enough to grab a slice of the finish fresh up in a field like this.
